explanations.en: Treatment may fall under exclusion: Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an accident, burn or cancer are excluded.

findings.fix: Ask your treating surgeon + hospital Medical Records before you submit: 1) Discharge summary with final diagnosis and reason surgery was needed for health/function (not appearance), 2) Operative notes, 3) A one-line certificate on hospital letterhead stating 'This was not cosmetic - medically necessary for [diagnosis], / reconstruction following accident/burn/cancer on [date]' with seal/sign. Tell them: 'Please write why surgery was medically required and if it was after accident/burn/cancer give date and details.' Attach these with investigation reports and prescriptions.

tool_evidence.advocate_argument: TPA flagged possible Excl05 with no evidence of diagnosis or cosmetic purpose. Without diagnosis, indication, or operative details it is impossible to decide if exclusion applies, so denial cannot be accepted as valid yet.
